sentences.text: The postmortem's lessons state that the most effective countermeasure against slow resource leaks is an alert on the resource itself, together with a long running test that asks whether the system is healthy after days and not minutes.

In line with this, action item AI-2 adds an alert that fires when connection pool usage stays above 80 percent for 15 minutes, and action item AI-5 adds a 72-hour soak test that runs before every release candidate.
